name: cypress-playwright-e2e-benchmark
description: Benchmark project for comparing Cypress and Playwright E2E test performance

scripts.test:playwright:baseline: npx playwright test --grep "login add-to-cart checkout flow|invalid login shows error|checkout without cart shows error"
scripts.test:playwright:ui-heavy: npx playwright test --grep "ui-heavy profile starts, filters, and completes with visible UI output"
scripts.test:playwright:cpu-heavy: npx playwright test --grep "cpu-heavy profile starts, runs computation, and shows deterministic result"
scripts.test:playwright:ram-heavy: npx playwright test --grep "ram-heavy profile starts, allocates memory, and releases it"
